results.name: determinism
results.claim: Same data and seed give the same selection and test score.

results.name: replay
results.claim: verify_replay classifies a rerun of the same configuration as exact.

results.name: no_false_skill
results.claim: On pure-noise labels the locked-test ROC-AUC stays near 0.5.

results.name: leak_detection
results.claim: A planted leaked column is flagged and leakage_policy=block stops.

results.name: bundle_roundtrip
results.claim: Predictions are identical before saving and after a verified load.

results.name: tamper_detection
results.claim: Loading refuses a wrong key and a modified model file.

results.name: interval_coverage
results.claim: A 90% conformal interval covers at least 85% of fresh rows.

results.name: drift_detection
results.claim: Monitoring flags a +3 sigma shift and stays quiet on clean data.

results.name: failure_isolation
results.claim: A crashing candidate is recorded as failed; the run still completes.
results.threshold: run COMPLETED, crashing trial not ok, another trial ok
